name: ghccoretolean-vscode
description: Verifies Haskell annotations through the audited GHC Core → Lean CLI and shows proof assumptions and model results in the editor.

ghcCoreLean.scriptPath.description: Path to transpile.sh, absolute or relative to the workspace root.
ghcCoreLean.scriptPath.deprecationMessage: Unused by the audited verifier. Configure ghcCoreLean.verifyScriptPath and ghcCoreLean.timeoutSeconds instead.

ghcCoreLean.leanDiagnosticQuietMs.description: Milliseconds of silence from the Lean LSP before considering the diagnostic stream stable.
ghcCoreLean.leanDiagnosticQuietMs.deprecationMessage: Unused by the audited verifier. Configure ghcCoreLean.verifyScriptPath and ghcCoreLean.timeoutSeconds instead.

ghcCoreLean.leanDiagnosticTimeoutMs.description: Maximum total wait time for Lean LSP diagnostics.
ghcCoreLean.leanDiagnosticTimeoutMs.deprecationMessage: Unused by the audited verifier. Configure ghcCoreLean.verifyScriptPath and ghcCoreLean.timeoutSeconds instead.

ghcCoreLean.verifyScriptPath.description: Path to the audited verify.sh driver, absolute or relative to the Haskell file’s workspace folder. Must implement verifier JSON schema version 1.

ghcCoreLean.semantics.description: Conservative refuses known semantic approximations. Approximate enables existing mappings for exploration. Neither certifies the Haskell-to-Lean translation.

ghcCoreLean.trustSmt.description: Accept SMT results that depend on Blaster’s unreconstructed solver axiom. They remain amber and explicitly labelled SMT trusted. Does not accept sorry or arbitrary axioms.

ghcCoreLean.timeoutSeconds.description: Whole verification run time limit in seconds.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Verification executes the workspace’s build scripts and Lean annotations.
